primary_ownership_materialization: For each compression item, its frozen SOURCE_UNITS array is the complete explicit primary ownership record. A parse unit has the unique owner whose SOURCE_UNITS array contains that unit ID.

effective_parse_id_set.effective_standing_overlay: R22P0121 standing/kind replaced by R22_EXHAUSTIVE_PARSE_V0.1_AMENDMENT_001; unit identity unchanged

projection_rule: Primary ownership depends only on the frozen SOURCE_UNITS arrays. Secondary audit reuse is non-owning and zero-authority.
